name: Campbell's Distribution Center - Findlay OH
type: Distribution center (740,000 sq ft; DHL Supply Chain operated)

fieldNotes.location: Roster gave only 'Findlay, OH 45840' with APPROXIMATE geocode at downtown Findlay. The facility is the $44M, 740,000 sq ft Campbell's distribution center (DHL Supply Chain operated) at 1000 E Bigelow Ave, Findlay OH 45840, in the Tall Timbers West Industrial Park along I-75, across from the Lowe's RDC. OSM reverse-geocode of the building returns 'Campbell's, 1000 East Bigelow Avenue, Findlay'. Locked center 41.0790,-83.6355.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance: a truck lane pinches at a checkpoint on the SE side of the building leading into the dock yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small 1-vehicle-footprint gatehouse structure sits directly beside the SE truck lane (visible at z18-z20). Classic guard-booth position controlling the truck entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a staffed guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door bank along the building's south/SE face serving a 740,000 sq ft DC; 50+ band, estimate ~90, flagged low-confidence (variable imagery resolution).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Two large trailer drop yards: a NW/W yard and a very large S trailer-storage yard with many marked rows; hundreds of trailers parked.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - the south trailer yard alone holds well over 100 trailers in marked rows.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~230 trailers counted across the captured imagery; estimate is approximate given resolution, flagged.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved aprons and ample yard width around the SE truck checkpoint - physical room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the DC sits in an edge-of-town industrial park surrounded by active agricultural fields, on the I-75 corridor outside Findlay.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Edge-of-town rural site but within an industrial park near I-75 and other large DCs; cellular coverage likely adequate - low confidence, flagged.
fieldNotes.staging: Paved post-gate holding area between the SE guard booth and the dock apron.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property (despite the park's proximity to the CSX North Baltimore railyard).
